text: This run looked at the voice-agents page for a collections lead in banks and lenders, with the goal to help more visitors start building. In the hero (the saved copy from 2026-11-15), audit questions A3-proof and A4-cta failed, which means the hero does not do those jobs yet. The writer tried variant A for launch speed, variant B for links to lender systems, and variant C for bank-grade proof. Jev and Judge 2 passed variant B as better, but held variants A and C because Jev flagged a phrase. A person approved variant B. The sandbox results are synthetic: the visitors are simulated and the numbers show the method works, not that a variant wins.
